entities.summary: Sakae Morimoto is a field hockey player from Japan. Affiliated with the Tenri University she played for the Japan women's national field hockey team, at two Summer Olympics, in 2004 and 2008. Sakae Morimoto was a athletes & competitors from Tenri (b. 1977-01-20, Tenri). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
